title: Advancing through true input bits
statement: For all natural numbers $z$ and $k$ and every Boolean list $r$, running the emitter from phase $n$ with vertex counter $z$ and both argument counters zero on a list of $k$ true bits followed by $r$ gives the same output as running it from phase $n$ with vertex counter $z+k$ and both argument counters zero on $r$.
